mapper.select: /* SQL_ID: com.hanatour.air.ols.flightPriceSnapshot.ec.qc.FlightPriceSnapshotMapper.findFlightPriceSnapshotList */ SELECT CAST(A.snapshot_id AS CHAR) AS snapshot_id , A.reservation_code , A.trip_type , A.is_direct_only , DATE_FORMAT(A.dep_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dep_date , A.dep_airport , A.dep_airline_code , A.dep_flight_no , DATE_FORMAT(A.return_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS return_date , A.return_airport , A.return_airline_code , A.return_flight_no , A.promo_card_code , A.seat_class , A.passenger_type , CAST(A.base_fare AS CHAR) AS base_fare , CAST(A.tax AS CHAR) AS tax , CAST(A.q_charge AS CHAR) AS q_charge , CAST(A.fare1 AS CHAR) AS fare1 , A.fare1_agency_code , A.fare1_agency_name , CAST(A.fare2 AS CHAR) AS fare2 , A.fare2_agency_code , A.fare2_agency_name , CAST(A.fare3 AS CHAR) AS fare3 , A.fare3_agency_code , A.fare3_agency_name , CAST(A.fare4 AS CHAR) AS fare4 , A.fare4_agency_code , A.fare4_agency_name , CAST(A.fare5 AS CHAR) AS fare5 , A.fare5_agency_code , A.fare5_agency_name , CAST(A.fare6 AS CHAR) AS fare6 , A.fare6_agency_code , A.fare6_agency_name , CAST(A.fare7 AS CHAR) AS fare7 , A.fare7_agency_code , A.fare7_agency_name , CAST(A.fare8 AS CHAR) AS fare8 , A.fare8_agency_code , A.fare8_agency_name , CAST(A.fare9 AS CHAR) AS fare9 , A.fare9_agency_code , A.fare9_agency_name , CAST(A.fare10 AS CHAR) AS fare10 , A.fare10_agency_code , A.fare10_agency_name , CAST(A.fare11 AS CHAR) AS fare11 , A.fare11_agency_code , A.fare11_agency_name , CAST(A.fare12 AS CHAR) AS fare12 , A.fare12_agency_code , A.fare12_agency_name , CAST(A.fare13 AS CHAR) AS fare13 , A.fare13_agency_code , A.fare13_agency_name , CAST(A.fare14 AS CHAR) AS fare14 , A.fare14_agency_code , A.fare14_agency_name , CAST(A.fare15 AS CHAR) AS fare15 , A.fare15_agency_code , A.fare15_agency_name , CAST(A.fare16 AS CHAR) AS fare16 , A.fare16_agency_code , A.fare16_agency_name , CAST(A.fare17 AS CHAR) AS fare17 , A.fare17_agency_code , A.fare17_agency_name , CAST(A.fare18 AS CHAR) AS fare18 , A.fare18_agency_code , A.fare18_agency_name , CAST(A.fare19 AS CHAR) AS fare19 , A.fare19_agency_code , A.fare19_agency_name , CAST(A.fare20 AS CHAR) AS fare20 , A.fare20_agency_code , A.fare20_agency_name , A.current_rank , CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(A.captured_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'), '+09:00') AS captured_at , CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(A.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'), '+09:00') AS created_at FROM FLIGHT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT A WHERE A.captured_at >= STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND A.captured_at < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{dateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY A.captured_at DESC, A.snapshot_id DESC
